key_concepts: Texture Map POP creates or transforms texture-coordinate attributes for POP surfaces, and the output does not have to be named Tex.
Projection methods include normalized/position XYZ, cylindrical, face-based, spherical equirectangular, fisheye, camera perspective, and triplanar coordinates.
Point versus vertex assignment, seam fixing, output attribute typing, and Texture/Transform page transforms determine whether coordinates suit materials, projection mapping, or multi-UV workflows.
common_gotchas: Tex is a float3 attribute and may live on point or vertex class depending on mapping needs.
Materials can use attributes other than Tex, but many workflows expect Tex, Tex2, Tex3 style names.
Triplanar mapping creates multiple texture-coordinate attributes for blending orthographic projections.
